series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2015, low-cost cloud services will cannibalize up to 15 percent of top outsourcing players' revenue.
entries.subject: Low-cost cloud services vs outsourcing
entries.metric: share of top outsourcing players' revenue cannibalized

entries.quote: In 2013, the investment bubble will burst for consumer social networks, and for enterprise social software companies in 2014.
entries.subject: Social network investment bubble
entries.note: 2013 for consumer social networks; 2014 for enterprise social software.

entries.quote: By 2016, at least 50 percent of enterprise email users will rely primarily on a browser, tablet or mobile client instead of a desktop client.
entries.subject: Enterprise email clients
entries.metric: share of enterprise email users relying on browser, tablet or mobile client

entries.quote: By 2015, mobile application development projects targeting smartphones and tablets will outnumber native PC projects by a ratio of 4-to-1.
entries.subject: Mobile vs PC application development
entries.metric: ratio of mobile to native PC development projects

entries.quote: By 2016, 40 percent of enterprises will make proof of independent security testing a precondition for using any type of cloud service.
entries.subject: Cloud security testing
entries.metric: share of enterprises requiring independent security testing proof for cloud

entries.quote: At year-end 2016, more than 50 percent of Global 1000 companies will have stored customer-sensitive data in the public cloud.
entries.subject: Sensitive data in public cloud
entries.metric: share of Global 1000 companies storing customer-sensitive data in public cloud

entries.quote: By 2015, 35 percent of enterprise IT expenditures for most organizations will be managed outside the IT department's budget.
entries.subject: IT spending outside the IT department
entries.metric: share of enterprise IT expenditure managed outside IT budget

entries.quote: By 2014, 20 percent of Asia-sourced finished goods and assemblies consumed in the U.S. will shift to the Americas.
entries.subject: Nearshoring of U.S. supply from Asia
entries.metric: share of Asia-sourced goods shifting to the Americas

entries.quote: Through 2016, the financial impact of cybercrime will grow 10 percent per year, due to the continuing discovery of new vulnerabilities.
entries.subject: Financial impact of cybercrime
entries.metric: annual growth in cybercrime financial impact

entries.quote: By 2015, the prices for 80 percent of cloud services will include a global energy surcharge.
entries.subject: Energy surcharges on cloud services
entries.metric: share of cloud services with an energy surcharge

entries.quote: Through 2015, more than 85 percent of Fortune 500 organizations will fail to effectively exploit big data for competitive advantage.
entries.subject: Big data exploitation
entries.metric: share of Fortune 500 failing to exploit big data

notes: Edition covers '2012 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: not stated (press release states no count). Found in public source: 11 top predictions.
